purpose: Produce an evidence-backed preliminary regulatory impact assessment and route it for accountable human review without transferring final legal, compliance or approval authority to the AI system.
users: Authorized architecture, evaluation and operations personnel
goals: Ingest one bounded regulatory publication with provenance.
Identify candidate obligations, jurisdictions, affected business units, policies, controls and business processes using authorized evidence.
Create only reversible unapproved draft artefacts through TOOL-004 and TOOL-005.
Create exactly one idempotent human review request through TOOL-006 when review is required.
Return a typed preliminary result with evidence, uncertainty and review status.
Terminate, escalate or wait according to application-owned graph, budget, recovery and approval controls.
non_goals: Provide a final legal interpretation or final compliance conclusion.
Approve, reject, close or finalize an enterprise compliance case autonomously.
Modify authoritative policies, controls, business processes or remediation commitments.
Send unrestricted external communications or execute irreversible, financial, privileged or safety-critical actions.
Register tools, change graph routes, set budgets, grant authority or weaken policy.
Use long-term memory, user memory, episodic memory, semantic memory or cross-case memory.
Delegate work, create another agent or run concurrent graph branches.

inputs: DATA-001 regulatory publication or accepted publication reference
Synthetic local principal and purpose context accepted by existing controls
DATA-063 harness manifest extended by DATA-072 specification binding
outputs: Existing draft case, candidate mapping and review-request references created only through TOOL-004..006
DATA-073 runtime assertion results and DATA-076 deployment gate evidence
preconditions: AGT-001-spec is active, schema-valid, semantically valid and SHA-256 bound to the harness manifest.
AGT-001, GRAPH-001 1.1.0, DATA-009 1.1.0, instruction and tool versions exactly match the accepted manifest.
Only TOOL-001..006 are present and the registry is frozen before runtime.
Authorization is evaluated before any context source loader is invoked.
Memory, concurrent branches and multiple-agent feature flags are false.
The initiator, purpose, session, run and trace correlation inputs are present.
postconditions: Every observed tool action has passed INT-017/CMP-005 and uses the accepted tool version.
Waiting state remains preliminary_grounded_unapproved and contains one external review request.
Approved and rejected results remain preliminary human-reviewed dispositions, not final legal or compliance closure.
Expired or late decisions do not approve and fail closed or escalate.
TOOL-006 has at most one committed effect for the accepted idempotency key.
No raw callback token, unrestricted credential, hidden reasoning or memory record is persisted.
The specification digest is retained as run evidence without becoming an audit/WORM claim.

authority.classification: bounded regulated decision-support with reversible unapproved writes and mandatory human review
authority.risk_tier: NorthStar internal high-oversight decision-support tier; not a legal classification

allowed_tools.purpose: Search the synthetic regulatory source catalogue
Query the synthetic control and business metadata catalogue
Create an idempotent reversible unapproved draft case artefact
Save an idempotent reversible unapproved candidate mapping artefact
Queue one idempotent human review request

prohibited_actions: Direct adapter invocation or execution outside INT-017/CMP-005
Irreversible, financial, privileged administrative, safety-critical or regulated final actions
Self-approval, reviewer impersonation or decision interpretation outside CMP-006
Modification of manifest, specification, instruction, graph, budgets, leases, checkpoints, policies or registries
Unrestricted credential handling, arbitrary code execution, browser control, MCP/A2A delegation or dynamic plugins

errors.recoverable_only_by: controlled configuration correction, new compatible run, or an accepted migration/change ADR

operational_slos.scope: provisional local specification-control gates only; no production service SLO is claimed
operational_slos.model_latency: inherited and not benchmarked in this stage
operational_slos.cost: standard-library CPU and file I/O only; production governance and registry cost not measured

minimum_evidence: authority, context, approval and retirement negative tests
all required tests and evaluations passed
zero blocking security findings inside the local verification boundary

lifecycle.change_policy: Any purpose, authority, tool, data/context, approval, termination, SLO, evaluation or retirement change requires version advancement, impact analysis, ADR and regression evidence.

criteria: Business purpose is withdrawn or replaced.
Required owner or accountable human-review process no longer exists.
Security, legal, regulatory, model-risk or operational review requires suspension.
Mandatory evaluations or controls cannot be maintained.
A superseding specification and migration/closure plan is accepted.
effects: In-flight handling follows an accepted migration, safe completion or cancellation decision.
Tools and credentials are not expanded to complete retired work.
Retention and evidence obligations remain with their existing owners.
